purpose: Perform one final outcome-blind YCB-V RGB-D validation of the RU-APC-developed measurement-first confidence gate.

source.scene_discovery: Use every numeric scene directory supplied under test/ by the hash-pinned official ycbv_test_all.zip; sort by integer scene ID.
source.clock: Order frames by BOP image ID within each scene and use a nominal 30 Hz clock; hardware timestamps are unavailable.
source.association: Oracle object identity from scene_gt.json. A repeated instance of the same target object in one frame is forbidden.

source_encoding_adapter.rotation: Use the shared strict BOP parser when it passes. Otherwise permit nearest-SO(3) SVD projection only inside the predeclared LM-O-derived bounds: orthogonality infinity norm <= 0.02, determinant > 0, singular values in [0.99, 1.01], projected determinant +1, projection max-absolute correction <= 0.01, and Frobenius correction <= 0.02.
source_encoding_adapter.visible_mask_metadata: The decoded PNG is authoritative. Accept archived px_count_visib only when actual-minus-declared differs by at most two pixels; reject larger differences before selection.

limitations: ground-truth visible masks as isolated pose-estimator inputs
sealed replay rather than live hardware

selection.observation_available: A GT-present target frame is available only when decoded visible-mask area is at least 0.001 of the image, valid-depth ratio inside the mask is at least 0.5, and at least four visible masked depth pixels are valid.
selection.gt_absent_frame_policy: Exclude from replay because pose error is not evaluable; never count it as natural missing.
selection.window_rule: For each of the 21 target object IDs, split GT-present rows by scene and source-frame continuity. Among eligible 128-frame windows starting available, choose the window with most naturally unavailable frames and break ties by lowest scene ID then earliest source image ID.
selection.track_rule: Select at most one deterministic window per object. Retain every eligible object and require at least 14 represented objects/tracks.
selection.preinitialization: Every selected window starts with an available FoundationPose measurement.

baseline.role: Sole persistent pose-state owner for baseline and proposed outputs.

proposed.selection_source: Modal winner in all 14 M5-R6A leave-one-object-out folds.
proposed.raw_foundationpose_score_policy: Record top score and margin for audit, but exclude both from filtering and confidence.
proposed.forced_reacquisition_policy: Forbidden. No counter or measurement can take persistent pose ownership.

evaluation.primary_aggregation: One track per represented object followed by equal-weight macro mean across all selected objects.
evaluation.missing_frame_loss: The same macro-object aggregation restricted to naturally unavailable GT-present frames and objects with at least one such frame.
evaluation.confidence_metric: Spearman correlation between proposed uncertainty and proposed normalized pose error on all naturally unavailable frames.

bootstrap.unit: Paired hierarchical resampling of represented objects, then complete tracks within sampled objects.
bootstrap.reported_bound: 10th percentile of paired all-frame relative macro-object improvement.

single_open_policy.first_label_open: The committed builder's first read of any YCB-V scene_gt.json or scene_gt_info.json is the sealed label open.
single_open_policy.failure_policy: Any input-feasibility, inference-completeness, numerical, structural, or uncertainty gate failure is the final sealed result. Do not alter the method, candidate, support rule, selection, metric, or gate on YCB-V.

claim_boundary.allowed_if_passed: One object-disjoint YCB-V RGB-D replay validation with nominal timing, oracle association, GT visible masks, deterministic outcome-blind track selection, fixed measurement-first candidate, exact nearest missing fallback, and object-local uncertainty.
forbidden: claiming missing-frame pose improvement from structural equality alone
any YCB-V-driven method or threshold adjustment

execution_order: commit this protocol, builder, sealed inference runner, sealed evaluator, and tests while every YCB-V archive and extracted directory is absent
download and verify the three hash-pinned YCB-V archives
extract official models and test data
invoke the builder once; an input-feasibility failure is final
run label-blind FoundationPose inference once on every available selected frame
validate inference completeness and integrity without reading evaluator labels
invoke the fixed-candidate sealed evaluator once
record the final pass or failure without retuning
